description:
Totals one dish from its ingredient list and reports it per serving.

Ingredient quantities are for the whole dish, as a recipe states them.
per_serving divides by servings, whole_recipe holds the undivided totals,
and the assessment covers one serving.

ingredients.description: Ingredients, each with a food name or fdc_id and a portion or grams, e.g. {"food": "eggplant", "portion": "2 medium"}.

fdc_id.description: FoodData Central id, which pins an exact food.

grams.description: Weight in grams, in place of a portion.

portion.description: Portion such as 2 tbsp, 1/2 cup, 1 medium, or 150 g.

servings.description: Servings the recipe yields. Defaults to 1.

name: analyze_recipe
title: Analyze a recipe
